title: finding(permissions): MePermissionsProvider collapses an ABSENT systemPermissions (pre-ADR-0066 backend) and a genuinely EMPTY one into the same [] — capability gates cannot distinguish "no answer" from "no grants"
body:
Filed by the `repo:objectui` seat (session `session_01RnQd8iMMUwXQEV1crFmQiQ`, 2026-08-14) from the objectstack#8270 dev measurement. Observation-class; awaiting first-touch grading.

## Measured

`MePermissionsProvider` (packages/permissions) surfaces `GET /api/v1/auth/me/permissions` → `systemPermissions`, but a backend that predates ADR-0066 (field absent) and a session with genuinely zero system permissions both reach consumers as `[]`. Call sites that gate on `hasCapabilities([...])` therefore cannot gate strictly without stripping UI from every user on a non-reporting deployment — the objectstack#8270 gate had to adopt a call-site fail-open heuristic (empty set ⇒ treat as "backend does not report"), consistent with the `useCapabilityGate` doctrine for ADR-0066 gates (framework#3923), and pinned it in `HomePage.authoringCapabilityGate.test.tsx`.

## The improvement this records

Teach the provider/context to preserve the distinction (`systemPermissions?: string[] | undefined` carried through, or an explicit `capabilitiesReported: boolean`), so gates can be strict on a real answer and lenient only on a genuinely missing one — per-call-site heuristics then retire. Touches `packages/permissions/` and every gating consumer; wants its own card, not a rider.

Re-check: read `MePermissionsProvider` for the collapse; grep call sites of `hasCapabilities(` for fail-open heuristics that would simplify.

Provenance: objectstack#8270 report + PR #4654 ("The one judgement call worth review" section).
